# Docking Studio

Docking Studio: A molecular simulation module that predicts the binding affinity between proteins and small molecules.

text: Docking Studio provides 3D visualizations, allowing researchers to perform virtual screenings of chemical libraries and optimize lead compounds for discovery.

text: Docking Studio can be reframed as a high-dimensional molecular interaction optimization engine that models protein–ligand binding as a constrained energy minimization problem over configurational space.

From a thermodynamic perspective, Docking Studio models binding as a free energy change:
ΔGbind=ΔH−TΔS\Delta G_{\text{bind}} = \Delta H - T\Delta SΔGbind​=ΔH−TΔS
where enthalpic contributions arise from intermolecular interactions and entropic terms account for ligand flexibility and solvent displacement.

# MutDock

text: MutDock can be rigorously framed as a mutation-aware perturbation model over protein–ligand interaction landscapes, where the central objective is to quantify how a sequence perturbation ΔS\Delta SΔS induces a shift in binding free energy ΔΔGbind\Delta \Delta G_{\text{bind}}ΔΔGbind​.

Formally, for a wild-type structure xWT\mathbf{x}_{WT}xWT​ and mutant xmut\mathbf{x}_{mut}xmut​, the system estimates:
ΔΔG=ΔGbindmut−ΔGbindWT\Delta \Delta G = \Delta G_{\text{bind}}^{mut} - \Delta G_{\text{bind}}^{WT}ΔΔG=ΔGbindmut​−ΔGbindWT​
This is computed using a hybrid scoring function that combines physics-based energy terms (van der Waals, electrostatics, solvation) with learned potentials derived from graph neural networks trained on large-scale mutagenesis and binding datasets.
